notes: DRAFT. Source: Fribbels Castorice scoring.simulation(). Biggest guess: CRIT DMG body (proxy +4.0% over HP% body and +5.4% over CRIT Rate body); the Poet SPD condition (see distributed.notes) is the part to check in-game. Fribbels file: vendor/hsr-optimizer/src/lib/conditionals/character/1400/Castorice.ts. Fribbels line numbers in Castorice.ts: simulation 405-448, parts 407-424, substats 425-430. relic_sets.notes: First-listed relic set (Castorice.ts:442): Poet of Mourning Collapse 4-piece: -8% SPD, and +20% CRIT Rate (+32% under 95 SPD) before the battle if SPD is under 110 (lc-text.mjs --set 124). Her base SPD is 95.

ornament_set.name: Bone Collection's Serene Demesne
ornament_set.notes: First-listed ornament (Castorice.ts:446): Bone Collection's Serene Demesne (+12% Max HP; +28% CRIT DMG at 5000 Max HP or more, wearer and memosprite).

main_stats.notes: Fribbels options: Body CRIT Rate/CRIT DMG/HP%, Feet HP%/SPD, Sphere HP%/Quantum DMG, Rope HP%. Feet HP% (first-listed), and not SPD: Poet of Mourning Collapse gives her +32% CRIT Rate only under 95 SPD, and SPD boots would end that. GUESS: Body CRIT DMG. Sphere Quantum DMG (proxy +11% over HP%). Rope HP% only.

distributed.notes: Fribbels substat list: CRIT DMG, CRIT Rate, HP%, HP; no SPD. Rolls chosen with a throwaway proxy script (damage ~ scale stat x (1 + CR x CD) x (1 + DMG%), the 2 fixed rolls per stat, the per-relic cap, simple set and trace stats only, an assumed 635 ATK / 1058 HP light cone), not with Fribbels or the kernel. Treat it as a tie-breaker, not a result. Result: CRIT DMG 10, CRIT Rate 12, HP% 2. SPD: 0 distributed. 95 base + 4.6 (2 fixed rolls) = 99.6; the Poet 4-piece takes 8% of base (7.6), so 92.0, under 95. One distributed roll would still pass (94.3), two would not (96.6). GUESS: that Poet's "SPD lower than 95" check includes the -8% and the fixed rolls as modelled here; read it against Fribbels' implementation before anyone relies on the margin of 3.
